notes.title: Patch Notes 10/31/24
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list][*]Request Log rewards updated to show Boss Finn's beautiful face in Quest Rewards
[*]Boss Finn's Feeding Time now calculates interest correctly
[*]Deck Builder no longer softlocks when navigating to an adjacent empty card slot
[*]Deck Builder now consistently displays unlocked cards
[*]Sylvia's buff and debuff tooltips can now be checked more consistently on the Haggle UI
[*]Fixed an issue where Xid would appear in Deck Builder before cards were unlocked and softlock the game
[*]Adjusted how metal Xid's guitar was (previously too metal to display properly ːpotionomicsroxanneː )
[*]Adjusted Xid and Coffin animations so they display more consistently
[*]Boss Finn's Rank 3 scene now checks the correct relationship status
[*]Adjusted how the Potionomics logo displays so it will display consistently across platforms
[*]Journal UI now centers properly on wide-screen monitors
[*]It is no longer possible to load corrupted or incomplete save data
[*]Selecting items in the Recipe Journal no longer bugs the cursor
[*]Fixed a UI navigation issue that led to being unable to select the last card in hand with a controller
[*]Luna no longer automatically thinks she’s your girlfriend in the post-game scene
[*]Traditional Chinese localization fixes[/list]

[h2]Balance Updates[/h2]
[list][*]Boss Finn will stop by the shop more often
[*]Adjusted Boss Finn's customer interest amounts on Cozy, Classic, and Capitalism
[*]Adjusted Boss Finn's customer patience amounts on Cozy, Classic, and Capitalism
[*]Adjusted Boss Finn's customer price increase interest amounts on Cozy, Classic, and Capitalism[/list]

We also wanted to note that it takes a bit longer to get updates verified on consoles, but your patience will be rewarded soon enough console friends!

Love,
Voracious Games

notes.title: Patch Notes 11/30/2022
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed magimin sorting in the gardening screen so that it will sort by magimins instead of gold value
[*] Small UI adjustments on the filters in the adventuring screen
[*] Misc audio fixes for potion brewing and the competitions[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list][*] Xid cards - “Rhythm” doesn’t stack correctly. “Jingle” adds patience when used on 0 cost cards
[*] Victory confetti persists past the competition in some cases
[*] “Ferocity of the Squirrel” does not currently apply the effect from “Fuel to the Fire”
[*] Holding more than 15 cards in hand at once makes cards at either end unplayable
[*] Haggle debuffs - “Fuming” and “Tension” stack effects instead of increasing duration
[*] Gold wallet cannot go past 6 figures
[*] Save file play time breaks with saves longer than 24 hours
[*] Hero loot screen displays hero’s EXP gain, but level-up isn’t shown
[*] Hero’s EXP gain is inconsistent with adventuring “test” versus the actual amount gained at the hero’s return
[*] Using the ESC menu during a competition can cause weird game states to occur
[*] Interacting with a vendor’s shop UI before their speech bubble appears can softlock the UI
[*] Submitting a competition potion with a trait bonus that puts the value of the potion over the competitor’s goes into the card game instead of auto-winning[/list]

Love,
Voracious Games

notes.title: Patch Notes 11/10/22
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed events that have mismatched outcomes with the description
[*] Fixed Owl’s Mulligan sending stress cards into the discard pile
[*] Fixed Roxanne applying the wrong enchantments for certain options
[*] Fixed potions occasionally appearing invisible during haggle sessions
[*] Fixed music loops in Sylvia’s shop
[*] Minor Ice Tonics and base potions no longer display the same icon
[*] Misc typo fixes[/list]

[h2]Balance Updates[/h2]
[list][*] Roxanne's enchantments now help potions qualify for custom orders that require certain traits
[*] Updated the boss’ move set during the final competition[/list]

[h2]QoL Updates[/h2]
[list][*] Shelf bonus is now visibly applied to the potion price when placing the potion on the shelf
[*] You can no longer receive multiples of the same wallpaper or flooring[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list][*] Xid cards - “Rhythm” doesn’t stack correctly. “Jingle” adds patience when used on 0 cost cards
[*] Victory confetti persists past the competition in some cases
[*] “Ferocity of the Squirrel” does not currently apply the effect from “Fuel to the Fire”
[*] Holding more than 15 cards in hand at once makes cards at either end unplayable
[*] Haggle debuffs - “Fuming” and “Tension” stack effects instead of increasing duration
[*] Gold wallet cannot go past 6 figures
[*] Save file play time breaks with saves longer than 24 hours
[*] Hero loot screen displays hero’s EXP gain, but level-up isn’t shown
[*] Hero’s EXP gain is inconsistent with adventuring “test” versus the actual amount gained at the hero’s return
[*] Using the ESC menu during a competition can cause weird game states to occur
[*] Interacting with a vendor’s shop UI before their speech bubble appears can softlock the UI
[*] Submitting a competition potion with a trait bonus that puts the value of the potion over the competitor’s goes into the card game instead of auto-winning[/list]

[h2]Workarounds[/h2]
[h3]Fullscreen display setting results in rendering issues[/h3]
Alt-tabbing while using the “Fullscreen” display mode, or any other activity on Windows that shifts the focus out of the game, will cause the game to only display a small portion of the screen.
[b]Use Alt + Enter, Ctrl + Enter, or F11 to get out of it. For now, please play using the “Borderless” display option if you are experiencing instability in fullscreen.[/b]

[h2]Need More Information[/h2]
We need more information on these issues while we try to reproduce them on our end, so if you’re able to we’d appreciate if you sent the following to support@xseedgames.com:
[olist]
[*]A zip file of your save data located here:
[Game Installation Folder]/Potionomics/Binaries/Win64
[*]  A zip of all the additional save data here::
%USERPROFILE%/AppData/Local/Potionomics/Saved/SaveGames
[*] Screenshot of your in-game config settings
[*] Your PC's DxDiag output as a .txt file (https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/4028644/windows-open-and-run-dxdiagexe)
[*] For visible bugs, please submit a video with ~30 seconds leading up to the bug occurring if possible.[/olist]
[h3]Trait Icons are hard to read [/h3]
If you are having trouble differentiating between the Trait icons due to the color, please reach out to us at support@xseedgames.com. We would love to get in touch and see what we can do to improve the icon design.


Love, Voracious Games

notes.title: Patch Notes 10/27/22
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed custom orders not appearing in the list after accepting them
[*] Fixed issue with potions not being able to be turned in under certain circumstances
[*] Fixed cauldron duplication bug
[*] Multiple window pop-ups no longer appear after shipping custom orders
[*] Owl should appear properly after Boss Finn’s competition
[*] Fixed incorrect region icons showing up in ingredient loot tooltips for Shadow Steppe, Storm Plains, Crystalline Forest, and Ice Craggs
[*] Baptiste no longer gives ingredients outside of unlocked areas
[*] Luna’s Sight Enhancer event no longer incorrectly uses Radiation Tonics, and vice versa
[*] Platinum Slime has D magimins again
[*] Slime bulbs now reset properly in second playthrough
[*] Xid’s unlock quest is now available for corrupted saves where you got the quest but it didn’t show up in your custom orders
[*] Updated screens to scale correctly by resolution (Detailed card view, selecting potions during competitions)
[*] Fixed minor text errors for adventuring, events, and Anubia’s competition
[*] Updated Quinn’s ingredient order screen to only be opened once
[*] Owl no longer lingers after the ending sequence
[*] Ambient music from a competition no longer carries over to other scenes[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[h3]Fullscreen display setting results in rendering issues[/h3]
Alt-tabbing while using the “Fullscreen” display mode, or any other activity on Windows that shifts the focus out of the game, will cause the game to only display a small portion of the screen.
[b]Use Alt + Enter, Ctrl + Enter, or F11 to get out of it. For now, please play using the “Borderless” display option if you are experiencing instability in fullscreen.[/b]

[h3]“Ferocity of the Squirrel” does not currently apply the effect from “Fuel to the Fire.”[/h3]
The tooltip will show that the effect is doubled when Ferocity of the Squirrel is in effect but will not actually apply it to the customer or judge.

[h2]Need More Information[/h2]
We need more information on these issues while we try to reproduce them on our end, so if you’re able to we’d appreciate if you sent the following to support@xseedgames.com:
[olist]
[*] Your save data located here:
[Game Installation Folder]/Potionomics/Binaries/Win64
[*] The additional save data here:
%USERPROFILE%/AppData/Local/Potionomics/Saved/SaveGames
[*] Screenshot of your in-game config settings
[*] Your PC's DxDiag output as a .txt file (https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/4028644/windows-open-and-run-dxdiagexe)
[*] For visible bugs, please submit a video with ~30 seconds leading up to the bug occurring if possible.
[/olist]
[h3]Trait Icons are hard to read [/h3]
If you are having trouble differentiating between the Trait icons due to the color, please reach out to us at support@xseedgames.com. We would love to get in touch and see what we can do to improve the icon design.

[h3]Vendors showing up without any UI[/h3]
Some players have reported that traveling between vendors using the sidebar travel menu causes the vendor UI to disappear. If this is occurring for you, please send us both sets of save data (as detailed above)!
[b]A reported fix for this is using the travel map instead when selecting areas to visit.[/b]


Love, Voracious Games
